body: Did you name this provider `TemporaryConfigSourceProvider`? Because the exception seems to be about a class that already exists in Quarkus: [TemporaryConfigSourceProvider.java](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/blob/master/core/runtime/src/main/java/io/quarkus/runtime/configuration/TemporaryConfigSourceProvider.java)

Could you check what happens in `ConfigurationSetup#addDiscoveredSources()` ?

Because this source should be added in the `ServiceProviderBuildItem` and thus added for reflection. So there's something fishy going on.

I see only mine:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1868933/62943359-93b2ce80-bdda-11e9-9112-7ddb63ec2cda.png)

Looks like the quarkus-core artifact is for some reason not taken into account by jandex.
So what we need to understand is what triggers the issue when adding a custom source provider.
